observations.body: Dew, deep, sun, moon, ancient hills, the bush, firstborn strength, and the peoples of Ephraim and Manasseh gather around Joseph’s name.
observations.label: Moses blesses Joseph’s land and strength

observations.body: The passage presents Moses blesses Joseph as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Moses blesses Joseph

observations.body: The passage places Favor is sought from the one who lived in the bush beside Moses blesses Joseph.
observations.label: Favor is sought from the one who lived in the bush

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 33:13–17 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states dew, deep, sun, moon, ancient hills, the bush, firstborn strength, and the peoples of Ephraim and Manasseh gather around Joseph’s name. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: Moses blesses Joseph’s land and strength
